positive_cases.name: success_auditing_removed

positive_cases.rationale: Audit policy change and removal selections both match.

positive_cases.name: failure_auditing_removed

positive_cases.rationale: Audit policy change and removal selections both match.

negative_cases.name: success_auditing_added
negative_cases.scenario: Success auditing added to a subcategory during hardening.
negative_cases.rationale: The removal selection does not match.

negative_cases.name: security_log_cleared

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
